June (PM): Short sync - we need a practical roadmap doc for routing lanes: affinity, strict residency, overflow. Goal: clear launch gates, ownership, and pilot checklist.

Arun (Platform): Proposal: break into 3 waves - internal alpha (canary-only), invited pilot (opt-in tenants), staged GA (enterprise then self-serve). Each wave must hit telemetry gates and a canary pass.

Bea (SRE): Key ops requirements: per-tenant kill-switch, global residency toggle, and auto-fallback circuit that flips after sustained latency > threshold. Add alerts for placement-mismatch and pinned-node queueing.

Tom (Product): Pilot targets: enterprise customers with reserved capacity first; mid-market for affinity testing. Pilot invite must include SLA language, fallback matrix, and pricing impact.

Arun (Platform): Technical constraints: avoid cross-region strong KV. Use control-plane authoritative placements and async cache replication with versioned placement tokens. Expect eventual consistency windows; doc them.

June (PM): Suggested gates:
- Residency fidelity >= 99% for strict-residency tenants over 7d
- p95 token latency within 1.5x baseline for pinned tenants over 7d
- Routing-originated 5xx < 0.2% over 24h
- Cost delta < 20% or explicit pricing agreement
- Policy change propagation < 60s for pilot

Bea (SRE): Runbook sketch: detect (placement-mismatch) -> mitigate (flip tenant flag) -> recover (drain pinned nodes) -> postmortem. Will draft.

Arun (Platform): Routing precedence sketch:
1) tenant.pin_region -> route if reserved capacity and healthy
2) tenant.prefer_region -> prefer local unless capacity below threshold
3) global.affinity -> cheapest compatible variant
Define capacity below threshold = node free slots < 10% or queue latency > 200ms.

Tom (Product): Add residency-status API and dashboard for pilot tenants; include eviction notifications in the SLA.

ops-bot: canary-deploy started -> cluster: lanes-canary-03
